title: Linear-Recurrent Language Model Architectures
description: 生成時に文脈長へ比例しない再帰状態で履歴を表す言語モデルのSSM、retention、linear attention、動的状態更新則と有界局所attentionとの混成を扱う。モデルの状態表現・更新則自体の設計を中心に、推論メモリ、速度、想起精度の関係を比較する。
distinctness_reason: Kernel/runtime families optimize how an operator is compiled or executed; serving families schedule requests and hardware resources; KV-cache families manage stored attention state. This lineage focuses on changing the language model's recurrent sequence operator or state transition itself to improve the inference efficiency and quality frontier.
boundary_rule: 主要貢献が、生成時に文脈長へ比例しない再帰状態へ履歴を集約するSSM・retention・linear attention・data-dependent recurrenceのモデル構造または状態更新則である言語モデルを含む。有界局所attentionとの混成も含む。通常TransformerのKV保持/圧縮/offload、純kernel/runtime、固定再帰decodeを主要機構としないFFT長畳み込み、test-time gradient updateによるneural memory、recurrenceを部品として使うだけの研究は除く。
scope_includes: Selective state-space and linear-time sequence-model architectures
Recurrent or matrix-state linear-attention update rules
Retention and dynamic recurrence language-model architectures
Recurrent plus local-attention hybrids with recurrent sequence modeling as the core
scope_excludes: Kernel, compiler, or runtime optimization without a model-operator contribution
KV cache, checkpoint, or recurrent-state storage/compression policy
General-purpose RNN theory with no language-model architecture contribution
Fixed-state decodingを主要機構としないFFT長畳み込み
Test-time gradient updateを主機構とするneural memory
